if test -d ./.git				\
	&& git --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then			\
  cd . &&						\
  git submodule --quiet foreach					\
      'test "$(git rev-parse "$sha1")"			\
	  = "$(git merge-base origin "$sha1")"'		\
    || { echo 'maint.mk: found non-public submodule commit' >&2;	\
	 exit 1; };						\
else								\
  : ;								\
fi
make  check-recursive
